inputContracts.road: logical Road network with explicit resolved per-cell mode
inputContracts.fenceRepresentationLayout: canonical ddv.fence-representation-layout@1 for captured/manual layouts; generated topology requires explicit ddv.fence-generated-layout-request@1
inputContracts.modeBoundaryBatch: WEP mode-homogeneous Fence networks plus native-reader modeBoundaryTouches; v1 writer admits only exact promoted FM01 boundary batch

identityLifecycle.preserveRule: preserve source GridObject ID and complete raw object only when the source native descriptor exactly matches a required resulting descriptor
identityLifecycle.deleteRule: owned source descriptors not required by the resulting representation are deleted as whole GridObject map entries
identityLifecycle.createRule: unmatched resulting descriptors receive fresh monotonically allocated IDs beginning at source NextGridObjectID
identityLifecycle.allocationOrdering: deterministic compiler descriptor order; not claimed as native DDV creation-order semantics
identityLifecycle.nextGridObjectID: before + createdObjectCount; deletion never decrements the counter
identityLifecycle.sourceObjectMapIntegrity: Grid.Objects must be an object map; numeric map key must equal object.ID; duplicate IDs rejected
identityLifecycle.nextGridObjectIDPrecondition: source NextGridObjectID must be greater than every existing GridObject ID

structuralMutation.sourceFamilyIsolation: owned sourceObjectIds must resolve to the expected source Road/Fence family; family replacement is allowed only through an explicitly supported replacement operation
structuralMutation.nativeSeedMergeRule: ROAD_SAME_FAMILY_MERGE must preserve at least one exact source descriptor identity

road.orientation: GridOrientation_Down only for generated current-v1.25 Road cells
road.mixedTransitionNormalization: only explicit already-resolved networks matching promoted patterns are accepted; generic mixed claims are rejected

fence.modeBoundaryCompilation: compile each mode-homogeneous network independently and reconcile one atomic GridObject-set mutation; exact FM01 only

preservation.unknownOpaqueFields: EXACT_UNCHANGED on unrelated and preserved objects
